description: Prefill / extend attention over packed variable-length sequences with GQA, causal bottom-right aligned (query i of an Lq chunk over Lk keys sees keys < Lk - Lq + i + 1). aiter flash_attn_varlen / mha_varlen_fwd, sglang extend attention, dense MLA prefill (MHA form).

hooks.cu_seqlens_qk: (name, spec, shape, dtype, sym, gen, device) -> {'cu_seqlens_q': ..., 'cu_seqlens_k': ...}: per-request (new tokens, prefix + new tokens) as served — chunked-prefill chunk sizes and prefix-cache hits from the case manifest, not a uniform split. Every key length >= its query length.

call: Invoke the varlen entry with max_seqlen_q/k computed from the cu_seqlens as the server does; return out (and lse when the deployment consumes it).

timing.cache: q/k/v were just written by the projections and rope; for long prefixes k/v come from the paged cache (cold). Record which.

negative_controls: align the causal mask top-left instead of bottom-right: every chunk with a prefix attends to too few keys
use cu_seqlens_q for both q and k offsets: wrong keys for every request with a prefix
pitfalls: Chunked prefill with prefix cache is the served shape; a UT with prefix 0 tests a different mask path.
An empty key range gives lse -inf: non-finite positions must be identical on both sides, never 'within tolerance'.
Prefill is usually eager; time it eager, but say the timing includes host dispatch for small chunks.
